professionalSummary: Payments Operations Analyst with extensive experience running daily nostro reconciliation cycles, investigating and clearing unmatched items, tuning auto‑matching rules, and preparing monthly open‑items reports for risk committees.
experienceHighlights: Ran the daily matching cycle for 38 nostro accounts at Penhallow Commercial Bank using the reconciliation tool, starting from the overnight statement load.
Investigated unmatched items by raising queries with correspondent banks over SWIFT and escalated any open for more than 10 days to the team supervisor.
Rewrote six auto‑matching rules for card‑scheme settlement entries; each change passed the change board with test results from the tool’s rule simulator.
Reduced open items older than 30 days from 1,146 at the end of March 2023 to 287 at the end of September 2023, as shown in month‑end ageing reports.
Drafted the monthly open‑items paper for the operations risk committee, including ageing buckets and commentary on the largest breaks.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Month‑end ageing reports for March and September 2023 exported from the reconciliation tool (1,146 and 287 items over 30 days), together with change‑board tickets for the six matching rules and the date each rule went into use.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience with daily nostro reconciliation, investigation of unmatched items, rule tuning through a controlled change process, reduction of aged open items, and preparation of monthly reports for the operations risk committee. They do not provide evidence of any other responsibilities or achievements beyond those listed.
